name: Joshua Campbell
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Seattle, Washington
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, General Litigation, Medical Malpractice
about: Joshua Campbell is an associate attorney at Dubin Law Group in Seattle, Washington, where he practices personal injury law. He represents the injured and their families in Seattle and the greater Puget Sound area in cases involving motor vehicle accidents, defective road design, wrongful death, medical malpractice and other issues.

A graduate of the University of Washington in Seattle, where he received a merit scholarship, Mr. Campbell received his legal education at the Thomas Jefferson School of Law in San Diego, California. As a law student, he was a recipient of the Thomas Jefferson Scholarship and served as research editor for the school’s Master of Laws program. He also worked as marketing director for one San Diego law firm and as a clerk for another, where he drafted motions and helped prepare cases for trial.

After graduating from law school, Mr. Campbell returned to Washington and worked as a contract attorney with a Seattle law firm. Before joining Dubin Law Group, he ran his own law firm, the Law Offices of Joshua E. Campbell PLLC, where he concentrated on personal injury law.

Mr. Campbell treats his clients with respect and compassion while aggressively seeking justice on their behalf. He is active in professional organizations, including the Washington State Bar Association, the Washington State Association for Justice and the King County Bar Association. He is also a member of the Loren Miller Bar Association, which is the Washington affiliate of the National Bar Association, the largest organization of African American attorneys in the United States.
